title: Majestic Craft | S2
description: The second season of the Majestic Craft Private Server
body:
## Majestic Craft | S2

General Information
- **Minecraft Version:** 1.20.1
- **Loader:** Fabric
- **Number of Mods:** 80+
- **Pack Type:** Technical modpack focused on Create and optimization

## Main Characteristics

### 🎯 Focus
This modpack is oriented towards technical creativity, automation, and creating complex mechanisms using the Create mod and its extensions. It includes numerous mods for performance optimization and enhanced gameplay experience.

### ⚡ Performance
The modpack includes many optimization mods:
- **Sodium** - rendering optimization
- **Lithium** - game logic optimization
- **Phosphor** (via Starlight) - lighting optimization
- **FerriteCore** - memory optimization
- **Krypton** - network optimization
- **LazyDFU** - faster loading
- **ModernFix** - general optimizations
- **EntityCulling** - entity rendering optimization
- **MoreCulling** - additional rendering optimization

## Mod Categories

### 🔧 Technical Mods (Create and Additions)
**Main Mod:**
- **Create** (0.5.1-j) - main technical mod for creating mechanisms

**Create Additions:**
- **Create: Connected** - improved textures for Create
- **Create: Copper and Zinc** - additional ores
- **Create: Enchantment Industry** - enchantment automation
- **Create: High Pressure** - high pressure for steam engines
- **Create: Jetpack** - jetpack
- **Create: Power Loader** - energy loaders
- **Create: New Age** - new blocks and mechanisms
- **Create: Structures** - ready-made structures
- **Create: Train Perspective** - train perspective
- **Create: Contraption Terminals** - contraption terminals
- **Create: Deco** - decorative blocks
- **Create: Framed** - frames for mechanisms
- **Create: Goggles** - information viewing goggles
- **Create: Numismatics** - currency system
- **Create: Railways Navigator** - railway navigation
- **Create: Armor Trims** - armor decorations
- **Create: Man of Many Planes** - multi-dimensional mechanisms
- **Create: Dyn Light** - dynamic lighting
- **Create: DD** - additional features
- **Steam Rails** - steam rails

### 🏗️ Building and Decoration
- **Chisel** - tool for changing block textures
- **Copycats** - block copying
- **Continuity** - improved textures
- **MCW Furniture** - furniture
- **Createdeco** - Create decorative blocks
- **Interiors** - interior elements
- **Dungeons and Taverns** - dungeon structures

### 🎮 Gameplay and Interface
- **EMI** - enhanced crafting interface
- **EMI Enchants** - enchantments in EMI
- **EMI Loot** - loot in EMI
- **EMI Trades** - trading in EMI
- **EMI Effect** - effects in EMI
- **Jade** - block and entity information
- **Jade Addons** - Jade additions
- **Inventorio** - enhanced inventory
- **Tom's Storage** - storage systems
- **Mod Menu** - mod menu
- **Zoomify** - zoom

### 🗺️ Maps and Navigation
- **Xaero's Minimap** - minimap
- **Xaero's World Map** - world map

### 🌍 World and Generation
- **Terralith** - enhanced world generation
- **Netherracked** - Nether improvements
- **Slice and Dice** - enhanced cave generation

### 🚁 Transportation
- **Immersive Aircraft** - aircraft
- **Man of Many Planes** - multi-dimensional transport

### 🎨 Visual Improvements
- **Iris** - shaders
- **Enhanced Block Entities** - enhanced block entities
- **Entity Model Features** - enhanced entity models
- **Entity Texture Features** - enhanced entity textures
- **Not Enough Animations** - additional animations
- **Skin Layers 3D** - 3D skins
- **Chat Heads** - chat heads

### 🔧 Utilities and Tools
- **AppleSkin** - food information
- **Borderless Mining** - seamless mining
- **Big Contraptions** - large contraptions
- **Egg Generator** - egg generator
- **No Chat Reports** - disable chat reports
- **Voice Chat** - voice chat
- **Open Parties and Claims** - parties and territories

### ⚙️ Configuration and Libraries
- **Fabric API** - main API
- **Architectury** - cross-platform API
- **Cloth Config** - configuration system
- **Yet Another Config Lib** - configuration library
- **Forge Config API Port** - Forge configuration port
- **Fzzy Config** - additional configuration
- **Cryonic Config** - configuration
- **Fabric Language Kotlin** - Kotlin support
- **Botarium** - mod library
- **Indium** - Sodium support for Fabric
- **Tectonic** - mod library

### 🚀 Additional Mods
- **C2ME** - chunk optimization
- **Lithostitched** - lithosphere optimization
- **ImmediatelyFast** - fast rendering
- **Dynamic FPS** - dynamic FPS
- **Server Core** - server optimization
- **Extra Mod Integrations** - mod integrations

## Usage Recommendations

### 🎯 Target Audience
- Players interested in technical mods
- Builders of automated systems
- Create mod enthusiasts
- Players who value optimization and performance

### 💻 System Requirements
- **RAM:** Minimum 6GB, recommended 8GB+
- **CPU:** Modern multi-core processor
- **GPU:** OpenGL 3.2+ support
- **Java:** Java 17+

### 🎮 Gameplay Features
1. **Automation** - ability to create complex automated systems
2. **Creativity** - many decorative blocks and tools
3. **Performance** - optimized performance even on weak PCs
4. **Multiplayer** - voice chat and group play support
5. **Visual Improvements** - shader support and enhanced graphics

### ⚠️ Important Notes
- The modpack is optimized for stable performance
- All mods are compatible with each other
- Recommended to use OptiFine-compatible shaders
- For best performance, configure optimization mod settings

## Conclusion
This modpack represents a balanced technical modpack focused on the Create mod and its ecosystem. The large number of optimization mods ensures stable performance even on weak systems, while the variety of additional mods creates a rich gameplay experience for technical players and builders.
